column1: # The uncited tests of code-clarity CC-12 AC 2 (findings 3.6): a `#[test]` that no proof, task check, inventory row, GAPS.md line or Book claim names.

# crate<TAB>target<TAB>test<TAB>verdict. Every row is `kept: asserts <what the test checks>; its nearest test in the file asserts <what that one checks>`. A body, assert-set and similarity comparison with every other test of the repository, and the same-file containment scan of fix round 1, found no test asserting the same rule on the same input. The guard `every_unnamed_test_has_exactly_one_verdict` (worklists) holds the rows to the inventory.

# T12 holds the three solver crates; T13 the other crates (lang, parity, api, transpile, root, interp, ir, cli, abi, plan). Fix round 1 removed six tests (the advance, queue and buck_example duplicates). Phase 2 fix round 2 completed every reason from the whole comment or assertion of its test (none is cut off) and wrote the two rows that stated no difference by hand.
